import json, math
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
rows=[]
for p in sorted(Path("inputs").glob("s*.json")):
 d=json.load(open(p)); s=d["summary"]; m=d["metrics"]; trades=d["trades"]
 assert s["session_status"]=="finished"
 meta=metadata[s["session_id"]]
 assert s["form"]["start_date"]==meta["start"] and s["form"]["finish_date"]==meta["finish"]
 assert s["form"]["routes"][0]["strategy"]==meta["name"]
 assert s["form"]["config"]==nominal
 assert m.get("funding",{}).get("effective_fast_mode") is False
 ledger=m.get("funding",{}).get("ledger",[])
 errors=[]; stats={}; prices=fees=funding=turnover=holding=0.
 ordered=sorted(trades,key=lambda t:t["opened_at"]); capital=10000.
 pnls=[]; exit_types={}
 for t in ordered:
  sign=1 if t["type"]=="long" else -1
  gross=sign*(t["exit_price"]-t["entry_price"])*t["qty"]
  cf=math.fsum(x["cashflow"] for x in ledger if x["trade_id"]==t["id"])
  errors.extend([abs(gross-t["fee"]+cf-t["PNL"]),abs(cf-t.get("funding",0))])
  executed=[o for o in t["orders"] if o["status"]=="EXECUTED"]
  errors.append(abs(math.fsum(abs(o["filled_qty"])*o["price"]*.00045 for o in executed)-t["fee"]))
  for o in executed:
   turnover+=abs(o["filled_qty"])*o["price"]
   if o["reduce_only"]: exit_types[o["type"]]=exit_types.get(o["type"],0)+1
  prices+=gross;fees+=t["fee"];funding+=cf;holding+=t["holding_period"];pnls.append(t["PNL"])
  side=stats.setdefault(t["type"],dict(n=0,gross=0.,fees=0.,funding=0.,net=0.))
  side["n"]+=1;side["gross"]+=gross;side["fees"]+=t["fee"];side["funding"]+=cf;side["net"]+=t["PNL"]
  capital+=t["PNL"]
 net=math.fsum(pnls); positive=math.fsum(x for x in pnls if x>0);negative=math.fsum(x for x in pnls if x<0)
 pf=positive/abs(negative) if negative else None
 errors.extend([abs(net-(m.get("net_profit") or 0)),abs(fees-(m.get("fee") or 0)),abs(funding-m.get("funding",{}).get("cashflow",0))])
 if trades:errors.append(abs(10000+net-m["finishing_balance"]))
 assert max(errors,default=0)<1e-6
 dd=abs(m.get("max_drawdown") or 0)
 pf_pass=bool((pf is not None and pf>=1.2) or (negative==0 and positive>0))
 eligible=bool(len(trades)>=30 and net>0 and pf_pass and dd<=25)
 start=datetime.fromisoformat(s["form"]["start_date"]).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()
 balances={}
 for curve in d["equity_curve"]:
  if curve["name"]=="Portfolio":
   for pt in sorted(curve["data"],key=lambda x:x["time"]):
    stamp=pt["time"]-61 if pt["time"]>start else pt["time"]
    month=datetime.fromtimestamp(stamp,timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m")
    balances[month]=pt["value"]
 previous=10000.;months=[]
 for month,b in sorted(balances.items()):
  months.append(dict(month=month,return_pct=(b/previous-1)*100,end_equity=b));previous=b
 rows.append(dict(session_id=s["session_id"],strategy=s["form"]["routes"][0]["strategy"],n=len(trades),
  id=meta["id"],stage=meta["stage"],start=meta["start"],finish=meta["finish"],dashboard_url=meta["dashboard_url"],
  net=net,net_pct=net/100,pf=pf,pf_no_losses=negative==0 and positive>0,dd=-dd,turnover=turnover/10000,
  gross_price=prices,fees=fees,funding=funding,funding_events=len(ledger),holding_seconds=holding,
  metric_open_indicator_pretermination=m.get("total_open_trades"),metric_open_pl_pretermination=m.get("open_pl"),
  directions=stats,months=months,exit_order_types=exit_types,eligible=eligible,
  positive_pnl=positive,negative_pnl=negative,best_trade=max(pnls,default=None),worst_trade=min(pnls,default=None),
  mean_net_bps=math.fsum(t["PNL"]/abs(t["qty"]*t["entry_price"])*10000 for t in trades)/len(trades) if trades else None,
  exposure=holding/(datetime.fromisoformat(meta["finish"]).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()-datetime.fromisoformat(meta["start"]).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()),
  gate_failures=[name for name,passed in [("trades>=30",len(trades)>=30),("net>0",net>0),("PF>=1.2",pf_pass),("absDD<=25%",dd<=25)] if not passed],
  max_accounting_error=max(errors,default=0)))
json.dump(rows,open("output/audit_stage.json","w"),indent=2)


groups={}
for row in rows:
 groups.setdefault(row["id"],[]).append(row)
aggregates=[]
for config, parts in sorted(groups.items()):
 parts=sorted(parts,key=lambda r:r["start"])
 assert [r["stage"] for r in parts]==["E1V","E2V","E3V","E4V"]
 assert all(a["finish"]==b["start"] for a,b in zip(parts[:-1],parts[1:]))
 source_trades=[]
 for path in Path("inputs").glob("s*.json"):
  snap=json.load(open(path))
  if metadata[snap["summary"]["session_id"]]["id"]==config:
   source_trades.extend(snap["trades"])
 ids=[t["id"] for t in source_trades]
 assert len(ids)==len(set(ids)), "duplicate trades across evaluation sessions"
 positive=math.fsum(r["positive_pnl"] for r in parts)
 negative=math.fsum(r["negative_pnl"] for r in parts)
 net=math.fsum(r["net"] for r in parts)
 best_fold=max(parts,key=lambda r:r["net"])
 best_trade=max((r["best_trade"] for r in parts if r["best_trade"] is not None),default=None)
 directions={}
 for side in ("long","short"):
  directions[side]={k:math.fsum(r["directions"].get(side,{}).get(k,0) for r in parts) for k in ("n","gross","fees","funding","net")}
 months=[dict(stage=r["stage"],**m) for r in parts for m in r["months"]]
 assert len(months)==24
 negatives=streak=0; longest=0
 for m in months:
  if m["return_pct"]<0:streak+=1;negatives+=1
  else:streak=0
  longest=max(longest,streak)
 aggregates.append(dict(id=config,unique_trades=len(ids),nominal_net_sum=net,
  nominal_net_pct_sum=net/100,
  aggregate_pf=positive/abs(negative) if negative else None,
  positive_pnl=positive,negative_pnl=negative,
  positive_semesters=sum(r["net"]>0 for r in parts),
  best_semester=best_fold["stage"],best_semester_net=best_fold["net"],
  net_without_best_semester=net-best_fold["net"],positive_without_best_semester=net-best_fold["net"]>0,
  best_trade=best_trade,best_trade_share_of_nominal_net=best_trade/net if net>0 and best_trade is not None else None,
  best_trade_share_of_positive_pnl=best_trade/positive if positive>0 and best_trade is not None else None,
  gross_price=math.fsum(r["gross_price"] for r in parts),fees=math.fsum(r["fees"] for r in parts),
  funding=math.fsum(r["funding"] for r in parts),funding_events=sum(r["funding_events"] for r in parts),
  turnover_sum=math.fsum(r["turnover"] for r in parts),worst_fold_dd=min(r["dd"] for r in parts),
  months=months,negative_months=negatives,longest_negative_month_streak=longest,
  worst_month=min(months,key=lambda m:m["return_pct"]),
  median_month_return_pct=statistics.median(m["return_pct"] for m in months),
  directions=directions,folds=parts))
comparisons=[]
fixed=next((a for a in aggregates if "_FIXED_" in a["id"]),None)
atr=next((a for a in aggregates if "_ATR_" in a["id"]),None)
if fixed and atr:
 for b,a in zip(fixed["folds"],atr["folds"]):
  assert b["stage"]==a["stage"]
  comparisons.append(dict(stage=a["stage"],fixed_id=b["id"],atr_id=a["id"],
   fixed_net_pct=b["net_pct"],atr_net_pct=a["net_pct"],net_improvement_pp=a["net_pct"]-b["net_pct"],
   fixed_dd=b["dd"],atr_dd=a["dd"],dd_reduction_pp=abs(b["dd"])-abs(a["dd"]),
   fixed_turnover=b["turnover"],atr_turnover=a["turnover"],turnover_ratio=a["turnover"]/b["turnover"] if b["turnover"] else None,
   fixed_n=b["n"],atr_n=a["n"]))
result=dict(aggregates=aggregates,comparisons=comparisons,scope="Four non-overlapping evaluations per configuration; independent10000resets, sums are not continuous-account performance.",
 max_accounting_error=max(r["max_accounting_error"] for r in rows))
json.dump(result,open("output/final_comparison.json","w"),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(result))
